shared_elements: raised relief figures against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces carry relief images organised into horizontal registers with rows of repeated small motifs and profile creatures, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a narrative human scene — a crowned figure and companion offering at a laden altar beneath a rayed disc whose rays end in hands, flanked by dense columns of writing — whereas B shows only animals (a quadruped, a crouching creature, a long-necked bird) and abstract signs with no human figures, no disc and no offering action.
